policy_notes.note: HUD 2026 Budget Management Letter: vouchers are funding-constrained. PHAs asked to stop issuing new vouchers (except HUD-VASH and FYI), pause new project-based voucher commitments, and cut payment standards, ending exception payment standards and staying inside the 90-110% basic range. Expect payment standards toward the low end of the range.
NSPIRE inspections for vouchers delayed to 2027-02-01 (third extension). Until then PHAs may still inspect under the old HQS (24 CFR 982.401). The checklist here aims at both.

Emergency Housing Vouchers are ending: families under EHV HAP contracts on 2026-09-30 move to Tenant Protection Vouchers by 2026-12-31 (PIH 2026-25); closeout from early 2027. For a landlord the lease continues as an ordinary voucher.
PHAs may use HCV admin fees for landlord signing/retention bonuses, security and utility deposits and holding fees (PIH 2022-18). Optional and per PHA; 2026 budget pressure makes them scarcer.

reasons: No city STR permit in force yet; draft ordinance pending: None in force. A new Title 12 Ch. 23 STR ordinance had its first reading at the Nov 24 2026 council meeting; the draft adds a business licence, STR permit, insurance and a 30-minute responder.
Caps/density: No cap in force. Reported draft: per-unit permits, with an enterprise licence for large operators under discussion; ADUs removed from the list of structures barred from STR use.

Pending: Committee advanced draft 4-1 (Sept 30 2026); not adopted on Oct 27. First reading at full council Nov 24 2026 (new Title 12 Ch. 23). A Dec 8 2026 hearing on rewriting zoning Titles 2-3 was also reported (unconfirmed).

permit.value: None in force. A new Title 12 Ch. 23 STR ordinance had its first reading at the Nov 24 2026 council meeting; the draft adds a business licence, STR permit, insurance and a 30-minute responder.

primary_residence.value: No rule in force. The draft STR ordinance (first council reading Nov 24 2026) as reported needs a business licence, STR permit, insurance, HOA-compliance certification and a 30-minute local contact; no owner-occupancy rule was reported.

zones.value: No STR zoning rules in force; council staff plan to adopt licensing and enforcement first and address STR zoning later. Current zoning has no STR use; hotels and B&B inns are limited to listed districts.

caps.value: No cap in force. Reported draft: per-unit permits, with an enterprise licence for large operators under discussion; ADUs removed from the list of structures barred from STR use.

max_occupancy.value: No STR rule in force; reported draft says the city would inspect and require operators to follow occupancy and safety rules (figures not reported). Until then IPMC 2015 404 bedroom areas apply.

taxes.value: City lodging tax 6.5% (Title 3A Ch. 6, code version 2021) plus state 4% in Jefferson County (Ala. Code 40-26-1). Newer local changes not checked.

listing_id.value: No rule in force; the draft creates an STR permit and puts permit data in police dispatch, but no listing-number display rule was reported.

pending.value: Committee advanced draft 4-1 (Sept 30 2026); not adopted on Oct 27. First reading at full council Nov 24 2026 (new Title 12 Ch. 23). A Dec 8 2026 hearing on rewriting zoning Titles 2-3 was also reported (unconfirmed).

state_preemption.value: No STR preemption found; cities regulate via zoning and business licences. State lodging tax (Ala. Code 40-26-1) covers stays under 180 days: 5% in Madison and other mountain-lakes counties, 4% elsewhere. Platform collection not confirmed.
